subject: design/argus-committed-plan-attribution
statement: Keep the content-bound `Argus-Drive`/`Argus-Bind` pair on every drive-authored commit. Add only the active slug's working draft and compiled PRD/design and problem record subtrees to the author-independent first-PR grammar. During `draft prepare-lock`, refresh bindings on replayed commits that already carry a valid stamp, retain unstamped commits as unstamped, and leave the Pyxis-generated lock commit unstamped. For an already committed valid delivery ledger, additionally admit only that problem's numbered plan Markdown/JSON and native problem captures. The planning-entry precheck still requires the actual binding lock and current readiness before drafting, freezing or projecting a plan. Treat stamps as auditable authorship evidence in the current single-user workflow; exact-head approval by the configured principal under trusted-mainline policy and host protection governs merge.
